ceremony.title: Relocate the lab
ceremony.blurb: The county is yours and the paperwork is somebody else's problem now. Pack one thing. The rest stays for the next tenant.
ceremony.noneBlurb: Nothing crosses. A clean bench and no ghosts.

veteran.name: A named veteran
veteran.blurb: One creature walks out with you — its scars, its temperament, its name. It will be the only thing in the new pens.
veteran.fine: It keeps what it is. It does not keep what it had.

bloodline.name: A bloodline
bloodline.blurb: A founding animal of the line you raised, so the new ranch starts from stock you already trust.
bloodline.fine: One animal, at the grade a founder starts at.

doctrine.name: The doctrine
doctrine.blurb: The philosophy the old lab was built on, carried to the new one instead of being rolled again.
doctrine.fine: Narrative only. Anatomy is where this game keeps its mechanics.
